title: Bounded-below sequential Hom continuity from constructible integral sheaves
statement: Let ℓ be prime, E a finite normed extension of ℚ_ℓ, and X a scheme with Noetherian underlying space. For the ordinary integral coefficients R of def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients, let M be a constructible R-module sheaf. Let D be a sequence of complexes indexed by AsSmall(ℕ), with colimit cocone c and one common cohomological lower bound for Q(D_n). Then M[0] satisfies the property of def-weil-pbc-hom-colimit-property for D⋙Q and Q(c): for every integer shift, the canonical filtered colimit of additive Hom groups into the shifted stages maps isomorphically to Hom into the shifted colimit. AsSmall(ℕ) is equivalent to the ordinary natural-number category.

source.place: Definition 6.8.10, Proposition 6.8.11(3), Lemma 6.8.12, and the proof of Lemma 6.3.14

proof.text: Good truncation at the common lower bound preserves the derived stages and colimit. The bounded-below qcqs hypercover calculation commutes with the relevant direct sums and filtered colimits: for fixed total degree the diagonal is finite. This proves the coefficient unit case and the finite perfect coefficient case.

First compare the library's local finite presentations with Definition 6.8.10. Evaluate a presentation matrix at geometric points. Descent makes the fiber module type independent of the lift. Flat going-down lifts generalizations through the cover, and continuous O_E-valued functions agree at comparable points, so fiber Smith invariants agree under specialization. The finitely many irreducible components of a Noetherian stratum, their generic points and intersections, give a fixed module type on each of its finitely many connected components. Near a point on the presentation cover, a smallest nonzero valuation entry keeps that valuation on a neighborhood. Continuous integral row and column operations eliminate its row and column; fixed Smith invariants allow repetition on the smaller matrix. A zero remainder is pointwise zero and hence zero as continuous functions. This gives locally a fixed finite O_E-module, including zero matrices. Its finite free DVR resolution and distinguished extension closure give continuity on local models. Pro-etale locality follows from the bounded hypercover calculation. Adjunction with restriction gives quasi-compact open extension by zero. For closed strata, express exceptional restriction by the complementary qcqs open pushforward and the localization triangle; its terms retain a common lower bound. Finite stratification and noetherian open-closed induction give every constructible sheaf source, with all integer shifts.

Apply Hom to the sequential telescope. The preceding bounded-below coproduct continuity identifies the Hom groups with direct sums. Identity minus transition shift is injective by induction from coordinate zero, and its cokernel is the sequential Hom colimit. The exact triangle identifies this cokernel with Hom into the derived colimit, for the maps induced by the original cocone. Transport along the unique colimit isomorphism gives the supplied c, as required by def-weil-pbc-hom-colimit-property.
